state.background: Final implementation checkpoint for P42-459. New tests/unit/useCpiChartDisplayData.test.ts uses renderHook with QuarterlyView rows 2005Q1-Q4 and 2006Q1-Q4, hiddenQuarters=[], endYear=2006. It verifies startYear=2005 returns 8 filtered nominal rows; rerendering startYear=2006 returns exactly four labels 2006Q1-Q4. In tests/e2e/range-change.e2e.spec.ts A1 still reads actual page range options, preserves current end year, changes start year through setRange, and after the real route update asserts the first nominal SVG bar is visible. Only the data-contract period-count reduction metric moved. P42-460..462 are unchanged. The unit hook test doesn't prove route-to-chart wiring or SVG rendering; E2E retains both. Plan, callsite ledger and matrix record this boundary. Plan JEV `p42-459-plan-jev.json` passed valid_as_defined, confidence .92, passProbability .93. Final verification: `pnpm exec vitest run tests/unit/useCpiChartDisplayData.test.ts` exit0 1/1; `pnpm test:e2e --project=chromium tests/e2e/range-change.e2e.spec.ts` exit0 11/11. This file is excluded from mobile-pixel, so Chromium was selected directly, no no-match attempt. Independent diff audit confirms scope. No tests are being run for this review.
acceptanceCriteria: The hook-level unit test verifies inclusive range filtering with exact 8-to-4 row behavior and retained 2006 quarter labels.
E2E retains real route range selection and visible nominal SVG bar evidence after range update.
The unit test is not overstated as proof of route wiring or rendered SVG behavior.
The focused unit and Chromium E2E evidence passed, and plan/callsite/matrix align.
verification: Current hook unit test contains exact 2005Q1–2006Q4 fixture, startYear 2005→2006 with endYear fixed 2006, verifies 8 then 4 rows and exact retained labels.
Current E2E A1 calls setRange(newStartYear,currentEndYear) and checks the first nominal `.recharts-bar-rectangle` visible; actual route/selection remains exercised.
Plan, callsite ledger and responsibility matrix record implemented boundary and unit limitation.
Vitest: `pnpm exec vitest run tests/unit/useCpiChartDisplayData.test.ts` exit 0, 1/1 passed.
Chromium E2E: `pnpm test:e2e --project=chromium tests/e2e/range-change.e2e.spec.ts` exit 0, 11/11 passed; this spec is excluded from mobile-pixel, so selection was intentional.
Independent diff audit confirms intended P42-459 scope and P42-460..462 unchanged.
Plan JEV prior approval `results/plan42/p42-459-plan-jev.json`: valid_as_defined, confidence .92, passProbability .93.
